about.title: About Me
about.professionalDescription: My professional career has always been driven by understanding problems, coordinating people, and building effective solutions. Today, I apply that experience to web application development, combining creativity, leadership, communication, and analytical thinking with continuous learning in Frontend technologies. I am motivated by building clear, accessible, and functional digital solutions that deliver real value to users, while working with responsibility, sound judgment, and a continuous improvement mindset.
